name: cx-goal-one-rule
task: Open the door and then pick up the box in the other room, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) forces opening the door first, so the extra Existence(door_open) is a goal of its own as the task commands ('Open the door and then pick up the box'), and the soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' since key_lost already encodes the loss happening while the door is closed.

texts: Eventually open the door and, after that, pick up the target box.
The door must be opened before the target box is picked up.
Eventually pick up the target box.
Try not to lose the key while the door is still closed.
